|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Vicrul]] (version 2 of 3). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Vicrul]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-vi-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Vicrul]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Vicrul]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Vicrul”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Vicrul (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 12 December 2025<ref name="ht-vi-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5637ac6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac6 5637ac6] (12 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.”
